description: Voter-ID meme on an American flag background, branded RebelNationUSA.com with a Facebook group watermark. It lists roughly two dozen everyday activities that require photo ID (buying alcohol, renting a car, boarding an airplane, etc.) and argues it is inconsistent to call ID requirements for voting racist. The list and the rhetorical framing are the meme's claims.
text: RebelNationUSA.com. This is just a small list of things requiring ID, but not considered racist. * Purchase Alcohol. * Purchase Cigarettes. * Open Bank Account. * Apply for Food Stamps. * Apply for Welfare. * Apply for Medicaid. * Apply for Social Security. * Apply for a Job. * Apply for Mortgage. * Apply for a Unemployment. * Apply Hunting License. * Apply for Fishing License. * Rent a House/Appartment. * Buy a House/Condo. * Drive a Car. * Rent a Car. * Buy a Car. * Register a Car. * Rent a Hotel/Motel Room. * Buy an "M" Rated Video Game. * Boarding an Airplane. * Get Married. * Purchase a Gun. * Purchase Ammo for Gun. * Adopt a Pet. * Get a Prescription. * Donate Blood. * Pawn Shop Transactions. Showing ID to Vote is Considered Racist? HOW STUPID IS THAT? facebook.com/groups/RebelNationUSA
flags: Political advocacy meme; several listed items (e.g. blood donation, prescriptions, some purchases) do not universally require photo ID — the list is the meme's claim, not verified fact

description: Screenshot of Q drop #1762 (tripcode !CbboFOtcZs, No. 2355012), dated July 30, 2018. The drop claims California, in debt and having lost federal priority aid over its sanctuary status, would 'light fires' and declare a state of emergency to request billions from the federal government — an unsupported insinuation that wildfires were deliberately set for funding. It links to Washington Post, Forbes, and LA Times articles about the DOJ sanctuary-law suit, California's finances, and wildfire funds.
text: Q !CbboFOtcZs ID: 486c34 No.2355012 1762. Jul 30 2018 11:11:43 (EST). What happens when CA is in serious debt and lost priority aid from the FED gov due to sanctuary status (illegal)?. Light fires.. Declare State of Emergency and req billions from FED.. Why did POTUS reject in the past?. Sick people!. The more you know.. https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/justice-dept-sues-california-over-sanctuary-laws-that-aid-those-in-us-illegally/2018/03/06/fd489c2e-215c-11e8-94da-ebf9d112159c_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.a09a30d0059a. https://www.forbes.com/sites/thomasdelbeccaro/2018/04/19/the-top-four-reasons-california-is-unsustainable/#e3dfc913a239. https://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-california-wildfire-funds-20171119-story.html. Q
flags: The drop's implication that California wildfires were deliberately set to obtain federal funds is an unverified conspiracy claim

description: Screenshot of Q drop No. 40 (tripcode !UW.yye1fxo), dated January 19, 2018. The drop asks which 'Hussein' (Q's term for Barack Obama) cabinet/staff members used private email addresses, listing pairs of initials (LL, HRC, JC, JC, CS, AM, RR, SR, JB, HA, VJ), and poses questions about 'ES' visiting North Korea, a private network he allegedly set up there, and the resignation of the 'Chairman of GOOG' — widely read as referring to Eric Schmidt of Google. It closes with 'DECLASS-POTUS_' and 'THE SHOT HEARD AROUND THE WORLD.'
text: Q !UW.yye1fxo 01/19/18 (Fri) 01:45:44 No.40. HUSSEIN CABINET / STAFF. Who used private email addresses?. What was the purpose?. LL.. HRC.. JC.. JC.. CS.. AM.. We don't say his name.. RR.. SR.. JB.. HA.. VJ.. Did Hussein use a private email address?. @what?. Who just resigned from GOOG?. Why was ES in NK?. Why was ES in NK?. What private network did ES set up in NK?. What private network did ES set up in NK?. Who else was in NK during this time?. What private email address did Hussein use while in office?. Why would the Chairman of GOOG travel to NK?. WHY WOULD NK ALLOW ACCESS TO ES?. Nothing is ever truly erased/deleted.. These people are STUPID.. DECLASS-POTUS_. THE SHOT HEARD AROUND THE WORLD.. Q
flags: Individuals are indicated only by initials; readings of the initials (e.g. LL=Loretta Lynch, HRC=Hillary Clinton, ES=Eric Schmidt) are interpretations, not stated in the drop
'Hussein' as Barack Obama is Q's established usage, not an explicit naming
The drop's claims about private email use and a private network in North Korea are unverified allegations
